case: domain-over-enum COALESCE parameters preserve target enum inference under shadowed search_path
contract: COALESCE(status, $1) and COALESCE($1, status) are each checked while a same-named shadow enum leads transaction search_path.
Native explicitly cast target-enum queries provide value and expression-type oracles for inferred parameter queries; the outer source column remains the domain type.
Literal NULL, empty text and SQL NULL inputs are compared for all rows, including the NULL source row.
A label that exists only in the shadow enum is refused with SQLSTATE 22P02 in both argument positions, and source rows remain unchanged.
remaining: Other inferred enum contexts, session/search_path combinations and the wider B3 matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
